name: Change Healthcare
hint: A client ID and secret from the Optum developer portal; sandbox-apigw.optum.com is the test host.

pick.name: eligibility_healthcheck
pick.says: Says whether the eligibility service is up.

pick.name: check_eligibility
pick.says: Asks a payer whether a member is covered (270/271). Body: {"controlNumber", "tradingPartnerServiceId", "provider": {"organizationName", "npi"}, "subscriber": {"memberId", "firstName", "lastName", "dateOfBirth"}, "encounter": {"serviceTypeCodes"}}.

pick.name: validate_claim
pick.says: Checks a professional claim (837P) for errors without sending it. Body: the claim, as for a submission.

pick.name: submit_claim
pick.says: Submits a professional claim (837P) to the payer. Body: the claim: controlNumber, tradingPartnerServiceId, submitter, receiver, subscriber, providers and claimInformation.
